stories.headline: Jensen Huang agrees to testify to three House committees on Dec. 1; Nvidia's lawyer follows Dec. 2

key_facts.fact: Jensen Huang will appear before the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence and China Select Committees on December 1, according to the leaders of the panels.
key_facts.excerpt: Jensen Huang will appear before the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence, and China Select Committees on December 1, per the leaders of the panels (Garrett Downs/CNBC)

key_facts.fact: Nvidia's lawyer is scheduled to be heard the next day, December 2.
key_facts.excerpt: Jensen Huang deve depor a comissões da Câmara dos EUA em 1º de dezembro; advogado da Nvidia será ouvido no dia 2

key_facts.fact: Daily Journal reports the former CEO and legal chief Tim Teter will testify voluntarily on potential national security violations and chip diversion to China.
key_facts.excerpt: O ex-CEO da Nvidia, Jensen Huang, e o diretor jurídico Tim Teter prestarão depoimento voluntário ao Congresso sobre potenciais violações de segurança nacional e desvio de chips para a China.

key_facts.fact: G1 ties the appearance to the case involving an alleged Chinese spy.
key_facts.excerpt: Jensen Huang, ex-CEO da Nvidia, vai depor no Congresso dos EUA após caso com suposta espiã chinesa

key_facts.fact: Separately on Nov. 17, Huang said he would be 'honored' to return as Nvidia CEO.
key_facts.excerpt: Jensen Huang says he would be 'honored' if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO

stories.headline: UK inflation climbs to 3.6%, a one-year high, keeping a second Bank of England hike in play

key_facts.fact: UK annual inflation accelerated to 3.6% in October.
key_facts.excerpt: UK inflation accelerated to 3.6% in October

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg calls it the highest in a year, driven by soaring fuel and energy costs.
key_facts.excerpt: UK Inflation Hits Highest in Year on Soaring Fuel, Energy Costs

key_facts.fact: The SCMP adds tobacco costs to the drivers of the 12-month high.
key_facts.excerpt: UK inflation hits 12-month high of 3.6% on soaring fuel, tobacco costs

key_facts.fact: The reading came in below market expectations despite accelerating from September.
key_facts.excerpt: Inflação anual do Reino Unido acelera a 3,6% em outubro, mas fica abaixo do esperado

key_facts.fact: ABC News says the figure keeps alive the risk of a second straight rate hike; the Guardian links the rise to energy prices and the Iran war.
key_facts.excerpt: UK inflation rises to year high and keeps risk of second straight rate hike alive

stories.headline: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid worst outbreak since 1991; Mexico also loses it

key_facts.fact: The US lost its measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers.
key_facts.excerpt: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers

key_facts.fact: The Pan American Health Organization revoked the certification after the country's largest outbreak since 1991, with more than 5,400 confirmed cases in 2026, per Daily Journal's summary.
key_facts.excerpt: A Organização Pan-Americana da Saúde revogou a certificação dos EUA após o país registrar o maior surto da doença desde 1991, com mais de 5.400 casos confirmados em 2026.

key_facts.fact: Mexico lost its elimination status as well.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S., Mexico both lose their measles elimination statuses: officials

key_facts.fact: The SCMP links the loss to falling vaccinations, with cases and deaths mounting.
key_facts.excerpt: US loses measles-free status as vaccinations fall, cases and deaths mount

stories.headline: Google opens Gemini Tasks, which can make calls and purchases, free to hundreds of millions more users

key_facts.fact: Google is expanding Tasks in Gemini free of charge to hundreds of millions more people in the US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia and India.
key_facts.excerpt: Starting today, we're expanding Tasks in Gemini free of charge to hundreds of millions more people in the U.S., Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India.

key_facts.fact: TechCrunch reports the expanded Tasks can help with calls and purchases.
key_facts.excerpt: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases

key_facts.fact: In the US, Tasks gets a slate of new features for handing off a to-do list.
key_facts.excerpt: Starting today in the U.S., Tasks in @GeminiApp can take even more off your plate. We're rolling out new ways to hand off your to-do list with a slate of new features.

key_facts.fact: Daily Journal says free users in the six countries also get the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, with automation of complex tasks and payments.
key_facts.excerpt: O Google expandiu o acesso gratuito ao modo Tasks e ao modelo Gemini 4 Hydrogen para usuários em seis países, permitindo a automação de tarefas complexas e pagamentos.
